issues.title: Its check for walls around a room fails on Build 42.22
issues.note: It asks a tile for its wall flags with get(IsoFlagType...), which 42.22 does not take (the game's own code uses has): "No implementation found for function: get(...PropertyContainer..., IsoFlagType WallN)". That check stops with an error each time; the rest of the mod goes on. Nothing to fix from here: its author has to change those calls (12 of them).
issues.log: ERROR: General      f:3> Lua((MOD:Realistic Temperature)).edgeHasBlockingOnSquare> Exception thrown
